Micro-Mechanical Engineering

The Tri-Part Escapement Architecture

Each subsystem is structurally decoupled to eliminate gravitational distortion, thermal expansion, and sea-surge acceleration.

Subsystem Alpha

Constant-Force Remontoire

A secondary hairspring recharged every second by the mainspring delivers an unvarying, linear torque impulse to the balance wheel, maintaining constant amplitude regardless of power reserve depth.

MATERIAL: Elinvar & Glucydur
Subsystem Beta

3-Axis Phosphor-Bronze Gimbal

Counter-weighted jewel-bearing suspension rings neutralize up to 38° of vessel roll and pitch, ensuring the escapement plane remains orthogonal to the Earth's local gravity vector.

BEARINGS: Grade 5 Sapphire V-Cups
Subsystem Gamma

Thermally Compensated Balance

Bi-metallic balance rim with slotted micro-metric gold inertia screws counters thermal contraction from North Atlantic freezing seas (-10°C) to Equatorial passages (+45°C).

TOLERANCE: ±0.002s / °C / Day
